import socket, threading, time
server=('10.100.48.10',9097)
count=12
barrier=threading.Barrier(count)
results=[None]*count

def client(i):
    req=b'PING\n' if i % 2 == 0 else b'OTHER\n'
    expected=b'PONG\n' if i % 2 == 0 else b'ERROR\n'
    with socket.create_connection(server, timeout=5) as s:
        barrier.wait(timeout=5)
        if i == 0:
            open('/tmp/legacy9097.concurrent.ready','w').write('ready\n')
        time.sleep(5)
        s.sendall(req)
        s.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
        response=b''
        while True:
            part=s.recv(4096)
            if not part:
                break
            response += part
    results[i]=(response, response == expected)
threads=[threading.Thread(target=client,args=(i,)) for i in range(count)]
for t in threads: t.start()
for t in threads: t.join()
for i,(response,ok) in enumerate(results):
    print(f'client={i} response={response!r} closed=True ok={ok}')
if not all(ok for _,ok in results):
    raise SystemExit(1)
print('CONCURRENT_PROTOCOL_PASS count=12')
PY
pid=$!
printf '%s\n' "$pid" > /tmp/legacy9097.concurrent.pid
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  [ -f /tmp/legacy9097.concurrent.ready ] && break
  kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || { cat /tmp/legacy9097.concurrent.out; exit 1; }
